event: Solenne steps from the exit portal into a Transition Hall lit a warmer amber.
The Hall is the usual size, but its silence feels full.
Tomás steps through, studies the light, and says the Tower knows they passed something.
The six stand in the light without discussion.
They clean up slowly after the fight.
Miriam tends the party with Mending Touch, starting with Dayo.
Dayo sits still for it and does not say she is fine.
Vesper inventories the unused Anchor Vials: six hours before they crystallize.
The First Boss Coat materializes in the inventory display.
Vesper turns it once and hands it to Dayo: this goes to you.
Dayo equips the Coat; her max HP rises to 497 and base RES to 18.
Dayo pockets her hand and does not add a tally mark yet.
The Class Selection prompt waits at a System terminal in the Hall's center.
Dayo goes first and places her hand on the terminal.
The System confirms Adaeze Okonkwo as Vanguard (Advanced).

changes.note: Class Selection confirms Dayo as Vanguard at the Advanced tier

event: Solenne feels the Steadfast echo through the Conductor as weight.
Dayo steps back, hand in her pocket, expression unchanged.
Miriam goes second, placing both hands on the interface.
The System confirms Miriam Osei-Bonsu as Warden (Advanced).

changes.note: Class Selection confirms Miriam as Warden at the Advanced tier

event: The Warmhearted echo is a sustained warmth; Miriam nods and steps back.
Vesper goes third, hands hovering a moment before contact.
The System confirms Vesper Castillo-Huang as Artificer (Advanced).

changes.note: Class Selection confirms Vesper as Artificer at the Advanced tier

event: The Openhanded echo is outward motion; relief briefly crosses Vesper's face.
Tomás goes fourth and selects without pause.
The System confirms Tomás Reyes-Whitehorse as Pathfinder (Advanced).

changes.note: Class Selection confirms Tomás as Pathfinder at the Advanced tier

event: The Clearvoiced echo is clarity; Tomás steps back.
Nadia goes fifth and makes a wry face at the terminal.
The System confirms Nadia Volkov-Baptiste as Jester (Advanced).

changes.note: Class Selection confirms Nadia as Jester at the Advanced tier

event: The Brightspirit echo is disruption and warmth together.
Nadia makes a silent joke to the terminal, then turns away quieter.
Nadia levels up from 8 to 9.
Vesper levels up from 10 to 11.
Solenne goes last and places her hand on the warm terminal.
The System confirms her Arcanist (Advanced) and makes Harmony Conductor formal.

changes.note: Class Selection confirms Solenne as Arcanist at the Advanced tier

event: Her own echo is all six Aspects at once, held together by the Trueweave.
At RES 19 Solenne feels the full Composite one point away, then steps back.
Within two minutes all six are sitting on the Hall's floor.
Solenne looks at each of them sitting in the amber light.
Solenne lays her staff across her knees and looks at designed and Almost.
Solenne tells them about the sealed spaces on Floors 5, 6 and 8.
She says the six Aspects were written into the Tower before Day Zero.
She says the Tower was designed for them, or people exactly like them.
She tells them of the Surge's chord and being one RES from the threshold.
Tomás listens with quiet relief at no longer carrying it alone.
Nobody interrupts; when she finishes, the Hall is quiet.
Dayo runs her thumb over the four tally marks on her bracer.
Dayo scratches a fifth mark, larger than the others, and explains nothing.
Nadia breaks the silence: six specific idiots in Chicago treating this like homework.
Nadia says she wants it noted the universe has extremely good taste.
Solenne laughs for real, the full, surprised laugh.
Miriam closes her clinical notebook.
Vesper watches Nadia wear the bandolier she made, and lets herself see it.
Tomás says the door is still there.
Dayo stands up and says, "Yeah. It is."
The terminal dims to standby; the six face Floor 11's door, ready.
